name: Robust Monocular Depth Benchmark
description: A benchmark and baseline suite designed to evaluate the robustness of monocular depth estimation methods under varied conditions.
evaluation_method: regression (common metrics: RMSE, Abs Rel, log RMSE / SILog)
general_score_metric: Abs Rel (and RMSE) — common primary reported metric for monocular depth
reputation: A targeted robustness benchmark used by the monocular depth community to evaluate model stability under varied conditions; moderate adoption for robustness studies.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark focused on robustness to domain shifts/corruptions; metrics are continuous error measures rather than classification; results sensitive to dataset splits and evaluation protocols.
